3. Nomination & Application Procedures
Nomination
(by Home University)
Student nominations must be submitted through the online form by the 
Home University coordinator no later than the deadline.
https://forms.gle/pcWmaGGQaNxhC1Go6
* Please nominate students within the number specified in our agreement.
* In case of a nominee’s withdrawal from the exchange student program to 
Sungshin, please inform us without delay.

4. Course Information
Qualification of Students
Any student (male/female) who meets the qualifications listed below can 
apply for the exchange student program at Sungshin Women's University.
1) Who is nominated by their home university
2) Undergraduate students that have completed at least two semesters
   at their home university.
   (Graduate students must have completed at least one semester)
3) Students who have above-minimum grade required by their home university
4) Language Proficiency in either Korean or English
   (Submission of official scores is not mandatory .)
* Courses may require a certain level of language proficiency
* Recommended Language Proficiency Level: Above TO PIK Level 3 or TO EFL iBT 71
Major Selection
Students will be registered in the same or a related major as their home 
university.
When applying through the portal, select a department that is the same 
as or most similar to your current major at your home university. If it 
does not align with your field of study, the university will change it to a 
more appropriate department during the administrative process.

Transcript Issuance
Ÿ Academic Transcript Issuance
  - Fall semester: Mid-February
  - Spring semester: Mid-August
Ÿ All students’ academic transcripts will be sent together by email to the 
Home University Coordinator.  Please note that original hard copies will 
not be provided.
Health Insurance 
Private Health Insurance (Mandatory)
Ÿ As required by the Korean Ministry of Education, you are required to be 
covered by Korean private health insurance.
Ÿ For a one-time payment of around KRW 80,000, coverage is provided for 
six months (one semester).
Ÿ The purpose of this private insurance is to cover medical gaps that may 
arise from the time you enter the country until your National Health 
Insurance coverage begins, which can take several months.
Ÿ The Certificate of Admission will be issued only after the payment has 
been confirmed.  Further details will be provided to students who have 
completed the application.
 National Health Insurance (Mandatory)
Ÿ National Health Insurance is mandated by the law.
Ÿ National Health Insurance is applied upon the issuance of the Residence Card.
Ÿ Details about registration and fees are TBA.
Ÿ Fees must be paid on a monthly basis. (₩80,000‒100,000 per month)
Ÿ Students with Japanese or French nationality are eligible to apply for 
the exemption. (Students must apply for the exemption individually)
Student Visa
(D-2)
All incoming international students at Sungshin must obtain a D-2 student visa.
Ÿ Required documents provided by Sungshin Women's University:
  1. Certificate of Admission
  2. Business Registration Certificate of Sungshin Women’s University
Ÿ Documents Sending Date:
 - Spring semester: Early to Mid January
 - Fall semester: Early to Mid July
u Note

- 7 -
 - After receiving the Certificate of Admission and the Business Registration 
Certificate from us via email, you can apply for a D-2 student visa at the 
Korean Embassy in your home country. Please contact the relevant 
diplomatic mission for specific procedures, required forms, and 
processing time, as they may vary by country.
 - The D-2 student visa is valid for a single entry to Korea. Without an 
ARC, you cannot re-enter Korea on the same student visa. Be sure to 
obtain your ARC before departure during your exchange period.
 - Please note that your D-2 visa will be used upon your first entry into 
Korea and will be invalidated when you depart from Korea in the 
absence of a valid Registration Card. Should you wish to go ahead with 
the above planned itinerary, you will need to apply for D-2 visa again 
for your exchange program.
Housing
Ÿ Dormitory Accommodation : Dormitory housing is available for 
international students.
Ÿ Room Type: Double Room / Triple Room / Quadruple Room (Room 
assignments may vary depending on the university’s circumstances.)
Ÿ Location: All dormitories are located within a 5‒10 minute walking 
distance from campus.
Ÿ Room Assignment : Rooms are randomly assigned by the housing 
manager according to the number of students.
Ÿ Application for Dormitory : On your online application form, select “Yes”  
to reserve a spot in the dormitory.
Ÿ In early January, you will receive a Google Form survey to complete the 
final confirmation or cancellation , along with further details.
Ÿ Dormitory Cancellation Deadlines:
 ‒ Spring Semester: July 31, 2026
 ‒ Fall Semester: January 29, 2027
Ÿ Payment:
 ‒ Method: Bank Transfer
 ‒ Deadline: Within 1‒2 days after moving into the dormitory
 ‒ Please exchange currency before arrival, as international transfers, ATMs, 
and card payments may not be reliable.
 ‒ Failure to complete payment by the deadline may result in eviction from 
the dormitory.
Ÿ During Vacation: Dormitory stay is available upon prior request.

Sungshin Global Friends
(Tutoring)
Tutoring (Language Exchange)
- Sungshin students (Korean) and international students teach each other their 
native languages.
- Enhances learning and intercultural understanding by encouraging students to 
improve their language skills through consistent study and cultural exchange.
- Global Plus Scholarship: 100,000 KRW for all participants upon completion.
Sungshin Global Friends
(Buddy)
The Buddy Program aims to support international students in both 
academic and daily life, and also share language and cultural exchange.
Ÿ Program Details
 - Free participation (no fee required)
 - Support for international students’ academic and campus life
Ÿ Requirements
 - Attend at least 10 sessions during the program period
 - Participate in mandatory in-person activities
Ÿ Eligibility
Only students who can maintain consistent communication and activities 
with a Korean mentor student may apply
Sungshin International
Students Association
(SISA)
Sungshin students and international students participate in various cultural 
exchange programs, experience Korean culture, participate in Sungshin 
Festival and share other aspects of school life
 - Support for International Students’ Campus Life
 - Planning and Hosting Exchange Events (Support for international students 
upon arrival and orientation, workshops, cultural experiences, Sungshin 
Global Festival, sports day, farewell parties, etc.)
 - Instagram: @sungshin.sisa (https://www.instagram.com/sungshin.sisa/ )
